title: Spring Festival Volunteers
transcript: Hey everyone, the Spring Festival is only two weeks away, and we're still short on volunteers for Saturday morning. We especially need people to help set up tables and tents on the main lawn starting at seven. I know that's early, but volunteers get a free festival T-shirt and lunch from the food trucks. If you can help, just add your name to the sheet outside the student activities office.

questions.stem: What is the speaker mainly doing?
options: Asking for help with festival preparations
Announcing a change to the festival date
Explaining how to buy festival T-shirts
questions.explanation: The speaker says they are short on volunteers and asks people to help set up.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention the T-shirt and lunch?
options: To list items sold at the festival
To explain what volunteers must bring
To make an early start more appealing
To thank people who already volunteered
questions.explanation: Right after admitting seven is early, the speaker mentions the free shirt and lunch as a reward.
